newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan auctions bonds worth 162.25 mln rupees.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan auctions bonds worth 162.25 mln rupees.

text.p: The State Bank of Pakistan said it had auctioned six-month maturity federal bonds worth 162.25 million rupees on Thursday at a weighted average yield of 16.9401 percent per annum.
The auction will be settled on Monday, it said.
The bank had set a pre-auction target of one billion rupees and received bids worth a total of 1.887 billion rupees out of which bids for only 162.25 million rupees were accepted.
In the previous auction on March 3, bids worth 10.248 billion rupees were accepted at a weighted average yield of 16.61256 percent per annum. -- Karachi newsroom 9221-5685192
